User stories

Epic - Find a Cruise from the Home Page

As a consumer, I want to initiate a cruise search directly from the Home Page, so that I can reach relevant cruise options in fewer steps.

  1. 01Access the componentStart the search from the Home Page.
  2. 02Select a destinationFind places the consumer wants to visit.
  3. 03Select a departure portChoose a convenient departure location.
  4. 04Select a month rangeFind sailings within a suitable travel period.
  5. 05Search with selected filtersReach relevant cruise options with the chosen criteria.
